title: Five children left orphaned after Las Cruces murder-suicide, police say
excerpt: Las Cruces police say Shane Perez, 46, fatally shot Angelica Aguirre, 30, before taking his own life Saturday while their five children, ages 3 to 14, were inside the home.
content:
Five children were left orphaned over the weekend in Las Cruces, New Mexico, after police say a man fatally shot his longtime partner before taking his own life while the children were inside the home.

Las Cruces police officers were dispatched around 8:30 a.m. on Saturday, October 24, 2026, to a home in the 4100 block of Calle Libertad, where they found Angelica Aguirre, 30, and her boyfriend, Shane Perez, 46, dead, according to a police statement.

Investigators believe Perez shot Aguirre before dying by suicide, police said. The couple's five children, ages 3 to 14, were inside the home at the time, police said. None of the children were physically harmed.

The New Mexico Children, Youth and Families Department helped place the children in the temporary custody of a relative, police said.

Police have not released a possible motive, and the investigation remains ongoing, with no additional information available as of October 26.
